def VTask.strongDownwardInduction {α : Type _} {p : Finset α → Sort _} {n : ℕ}
  (H : (t₁ : Finset α) → ({t₂ : Finset α} → t₂.card ≤ n → t₁ ⊂ t₂ → p t₂) → t₁.card ≤ n → p t₁)
  (s : Finset α) (hs : s.card ≤ n) : p s :=
  well_founded.fix (measure_wf (λ s => n - s.card)) (λ s rec =>
    H s (λ {t₂} (ht : t₂.card ≤ n) (hsub : s ⊂ t₂) =>
      rec t₂ (Nat.sub_lt_sub_right (Finset.card_lt_of_ssubset hsub) ht))
      hs) s
